title: Interlandelijke input-output tabellen Europese Unie 1965 t/m 1985
authors: Linden, J.A. van der, Policy Research Corporation NV * Antwerpen, Belgie, Oosterhaven, J., Dietzenbacher, E., Rijksuniversiteit Groningen * Groningen, Boomsma, P., Fryske Akademie * Leeuwarden (primary investigator)
contributors: Dr. Jan van der Linden, Driehoekstraat 304 (depositor)
descriptions: Intercountry input-output tables for the European Union 1965, 1970, 1975, 1980, 1985. These tables present the (changes in time) of the exchange of commodities between sectors of industry in the EC member states.
